files.description: Comprehensive tests for the photo gallery feature including image loading validation, year filtering, and pagination navigation

testContext: Tests require a running application at http://127.0.0.1:5001 with sample photos in the database. The gallery uses dynamic filtering via query parameters (year, page, page-size) and reloads the page when filters or pagination controls are used. Image validation checks both naturalWidth/naturalHeight and HTTP 200 responses. Pagination selectors use class-based locators (.page-btn, .page-info) and text matching for button identification.
explanation: The specification required three test scenarios: two were passing and one was new (gallery_page_navigation_works). I've updated the existing test file to include all three scenarios. The new pagination test validates: (1) setting page size to 10, (2) navigating through pages using Next/First/Last buttons, (3) verifying correct photo counts on each page, and (4) ensuring navigation buttons are properly disabled when appropriate. The test handles edge cases where there might not be enough photos for multiple pages. All selectors are based on the actual HTML structure from the pagination.html template, using class names like .page-btn, .page-info, and #page-size.
